_comment: Game RUMORS (idea #251). Each rumor is PARAPHRASED in Sami's own words (no quotes, no copied source text, no source links/credits) and carries a probability (integer 0-100) that it is true, shown as a visual bar/badge. Schema per item: { rumor (paraphrased text), probability (0-100 integer), date (YYYY-MM-DD), game (optional) }. For now this is the display layer + schema with hand-written seed examples; later the creator's research/truth pipeline will auto-generate these and write them here.

items.rumor: A sequel to a beloved single-player action game is supposedly already deep in development, with an announcement expected before the end of the year. Multiple loosely connected hints point the same direction, but nothing official has confirmed it.

Talk is circulating that a popular console exclusive could finally come to PC sometime next year. The chatter is consistent, yet it leans heavily on storefront listings that can easily be placeholders, so treat it as plausible rather than settled.

There is a persistent claim that a major studio is quietly working on a remaster collection of an older trilogy. It keeps resurfacing, but it has been denied once already and the supposed timing keeps shifting, which makes it hard to take at face value.

A long-running franchise is rumored to be skipping its usual yearly release this time so the team can move to a new engine. This one is mostly guesswork built around a quiet marketing calendar, so the odds it pans out are fairly low for now.
